Cartier Tank (1917 prototype): the story behind the wartime watch.

Louis Cartier created the Tank in 1917, inspired by the Renault tanks he saw on the Western Front. It was introduced in 1918 and entered full production in 1919, when six pieces were built. The prototype went to General John J. Pershing of the American Expeditionary Force.

The first Tank had a 23 by 30 mm platinum case, per Monochrome Watches.
